# Remi Visuals — Aderemi A. Salako

> Portfolio and blog of Aderemi A. Salako (Remi Visuals), a video editor and colourist working in DaVinci Resolve. Cinematic video editing, colour grading, motion design, creative direction and social content. Based in Nigeria, working worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aderemisalako.me/): Who I am, selected work and how to hire me
- [Portfolio](https://aderemisalako.me/portfolio): Selected editing, colour and photography work
- [Red Eye Effect](https://aderemisalako.me/work/red-eye-effect/): Case study — a cinematic colour study graded in DaVinci Resolve
- [Services](https://aderemisalako.me/services): YouTube editing, short-form video, DaVinci Resolve colour grading and content strategy
- [About](https://aderemisalako.me/about): Background and approach
- [Contact](https://aderemisalako.me/contact): Hire me for editing or colour work — hello@aderemisalako.me

## Blog

- [There Is No Light at the End of the Tunnel](https://aderemisalako.me/blog/there-is-no-light-at-the-end-of-the-tunnel/): Stop waiting to be happy
- [The DaVinci Resolve Node Workflow for Cinematic Skin Tones](https://aderemisalako.me/blog/node-workflow/): How I build a DaVinci Resolve node tree for cinematic skin tones: exposure balance, LOG transform, parallel HSL isolation and a soft grain overlay.
- [Are Men Polygamous in Nature?](https://aderemisalako.me/blog/are-men-polygamous-in-nature/): What if monogamy is the exception, not the rule?
- [27, in Retrospect](https://aderemisalako.me/blog/27-in-retrospect/): You don't notice the climb until you look down. A birthday reflection on turning 28, expectations and trying new things, by Aderemi A. Salako.
